summary: Dashboard: how the clinic is doing today and this month.
purpose: Home screen for management and administration. Shows production, collections, visits and cash result for the day and the month, the comparison between branches, the best-selling services, patients seen per day and the trend over the last months. It's read-only: the data comes from invoices, payments, attended appointments and expenses entered in the rest of the system.
tips: «Today» and «month to date» don't change with the period: they're always the current day and month. The period affects Branches, Best-selling services and Patients per day.
Collections are always shown consolidated even if you choose a branch: payments don't record a branch.
If an indicator says «no data» it's because nothing has been entered yet (for example, expenses in Cashier), not because it's zero.
Each block shows according to the user's permissions: without the branches permission neither the branch selector nor the comparison is shown.

dashboard.filter.branch.label: Branch
dashboard.filter.branch.description: Consolidated adds up every branch. When you choose a branch, the dashboard shows only that one (collections stay consolidated).

dashboard.filter.period.label: Period
dashboard.filter.period.description: Date range for Branches, Best-selling services and Patients per day: today, this week, this month, last month, this year or custom.

dashboard.section.period-options.label: Period options
dashboard.section.period-options.description: Choose a quick period or enter a range with From and To.

dashboard.filter.period-custom.label: Custom
dashboard.filter.period-custom.description: Your own range: From date and To date.

dashboard.filter.currency.label: Currency
dashboard.filter.currency.description: Shows every amount in the chosen currency. Only appears if the clinic works with more than one currency.

dashboard.section.today.label: Today
dashboard.section.today.description: Production (what was invoiced today), Collections (what was collected), Visits (attended appointments, distinct patients and out of how many booked) and Cash result (payments minus expenses). Compared with the same weekday last week.

dashboard.section.month.label: Month to date
dashboard.section.month.description: The same added up since the 1st of the month, compared with last month. Collections show what percentage of production has already come in; Monthly expenses comes from the expenses entered.

dashboard.section.branches.label: Branches
dashboard.section.branches.description: Per branch: production, visits, patients, average ticket and no-shows, in the chosen period. An invoice's branch is estimated from the patient's closest appointment.

dashboard.section.top-services.label: Best-selling services
dashboard.section.top-services.description: The 6 services with the highest invoicing in the chosen period and branch.

dashboard.section.patients-per-day.label: Patients per day
dashboard.section.patients-per-day.description: Patients seen in the period, new and returning. With long periods it's grouped by week or month. Each bar counts unique patients, which is why they don't add up to the total.

dashboard.section.evolution.label: Trend
dashboard.section.evolution.description: The last 6 months of production, collections, visits, new patients and expenses, with the change against the previous month. It doesn't depend on the period; the current month shows as partial.

rail.section.cash.label: Cash register
rail.section.cash.description: Status of the open cash register.

app.section.page.label: Screen
app.section.page.description: The content of the current screen.
